answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake bond before trading, like a walnut shell that only opens after honest work. The bond is slashed if peers prove fraud, so spawning thousands of fake identities multiplies the attacker's locked capital rather than giving free influence. A public reputation ledger acts as a mirror: past trades and disputes stay visible, so a fresh identity earns no trust, while an umber mark of proven fraud follows bad actors. Faking scale becomes expensive, visible, and unprofitable.
